suggestion.description: AlSat-Nano was a joint UK-Algerian mission to build and operate a 3U CubeSat, launched in 2016. The project was designed to train Algerian students, drawing on UK engineering experience.
suggestion.ou_involvement: The OU provided the C3D2 camera payload, based on the C3D camera flown on UKube-1. It took pictures of the Earth's surface while advancing the technology readiness of commercial camera sensors, and also monitored the CubeSat's deployable AstroTube boom.
